desc:
The gist of it is that both of them are RED and BLU.

Anyway, on one hand, I think a fairy nurse who genuinely wants to care for people (i.e. playing doctor) would be a fine addition to the roster. That is, I'm not saying she'll be good at it. If we take Piece here for instance, then I bet she's going to use her torch like an *Amateur Surgeon*.

On the other hand is [**Cegorach**](https://youtu.be/bM8YGsAmeqE&t=878).
